_comment: The node service's subsystem registry - the ONE list both sides read.
node-service.js dispatches '<prefix>.<method>' by loading the module named here,
and Rsx_Node_Service reads the same map so the two lists can never drift.
Paths are relative to base_path() (the framework's system/ tree),
which is also the service's working directory.
Adding a subsystem is: a module file, a row here, and a thin PHP client method.
